```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

# Read in swath data
swath <- read_csv(
  "data/PISCO_swath_site_mean_den_2016-2025.csv"
) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.character), str_to_lower)) |> # Change all string values in columns to lower case
  rename_with(str_to_lower) # Change column names to lower case

# Read in UPC data
upc <- read_csv(
  "data/PISCO_upc_site_mean_pctcover_2016-2025_EP.csv"
) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.character), str_to_lower)) |>
  rename_with(str_to_lower)

# Read in fish data
fish <- read_csv(
  "data/PISCO_fish_site_mean_bm_2016-2025.csv"
) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.character), str_to_lower)) |>
  rename_with(str_to_lower)
```

```{r}
# Create protection zone variables storing site names
new_smr <- c(
  "anacapa_middle_isle_cen",
  "anacapa_middle_isle_e",
  "anacapa_middle_isle_w"
)

old_smr <- c(
  "anacapa_east_isle_cen",
  "anacapa_east_isle_e",
  "anacapa_east_isle_w"
)

smca <- c(
  "anacapa_west_isle_cen",
  "anacapa_west_isle_e",
  "anacapa_west_isle_w"
)

reference <- c(
  "anacapa_lighthouse_reef_cen",
  "anacapa_lighthouse_reef_e",
  "anacapa_lighthouse_reef_w"
)

# Create a dataframe with sites labeled by protection zone for later join()
protection_zone_sites <- tibble(
  protection_zone = c(
    # Repeat protection zone label for the number of sites in that zone
    rep("New SMR", length(new_smr)),
    rep("Old SMR", length(old_smr)),
    rep("SMCA", length(smca)),
    rep("Reference", length(reference))
  ),
  # Add sites in order of their protection zone
  site = c(new_smr, old_smr, smca, reference)
)
```

```{r}
# Filter and clean dataframes
swath_clean <- swath |>
  filter(
    site %in% c(new_smr, old_smr, smca, reference) # Filter to sites of interest
  ) |>
  select(
    # Select columns of interest
    survey_year,
    site,
    den_lamfar, # Native brown algae densities
    den_lamsetad,
    den_lamsetadsub,
    den_lamspp,
    den_steosmad,
    den_alamar,
    den_coscos,
    den_dicspp,
    den_egrmen,
    den_eisarbad,
    den_eisarbadsub,
    den_neofim,
    den_nerlue,
    den_ptecalad,
    den_ptecaladsub,
    den_strpurad, # Purple urchin density
    den_mesfraad, # Red urchin density
    den_panint # Lobster density
  ) |>
  left_join(protection_zone_sites, by = join_by(site)) # Add corresponding protection zones to each site

upc_clean <- upc |>
  filter(
    site %in% c(new_smr, old_smr, smca, reference)
  ) |>
  select(
    # Select columns of interest
    survey_year,
    site,
    cover_sarhor, # S. horneri percent cover
    cover_erectred # Fleshy red algae percent cover
  ) |>
  left_join(protection_zone_sites, by = join_by(site)) # Add corresponding protection zones to each site

fish_clean <- fish |>
  filter(
    site %in% c(new_smr, old_smr, smca, reference),
  ) |>
  select(
    # Select columns of interes
    survey_year,
    site,
    bm_spul # CA sheephead biomass
  ) |>
  left_join(protection_zone_sites, by = join_by(site)) # Add corresponding protection zones to each site
```

```{r}
# Vector containing the understory brown algae that were observed at the sites during this time period. Those not included were either all NA or 0 and removed below
understory_brown <- c(
  'den_lamfar',
  'den_steosmad',
  'den_eisarbad',
  'den_eisarbadsub',
  'den_ptecalad',
  'den_ptecaladsub'
)

# Vector containing urchin species
urchins <- c('den_mesfraad', 'den_strpurad')

# Combine all survey data into long format for summaries
all_surveys_long <- fish_clean |>
  # Join 3 dataframes by year, site, and protection zone
  full_join(swath_clean, by = join_by(survey_year, site, protection_zone)) |>
  full_join(upc_clean, by = join_by(survey_year, site, protection_zone)) |>
  # Pivot longer
  pivot_longer(
    cols = !c(survey_year, site, protection_zone),
    names_to = "species",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  # Remove species that had all NA or 0 values
  group_by(species) |>
  filter(!all(is.na(value) | value == 0)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  # Group remaining understory brown algaes into one name
  mutate(
    species = replace(species, species %in% understory_brown, 'den_understory_brown'),
    species = replace(species, species %in% urchins, 'den_urchins')
  )
```

```{r}
# Create a summary dataframe for figure 1
year_zone_mean <- all_surveys_long |>
  # Take the mean of each species per protection zone per year
  summarize(
    mean = mean(value),
    .by = c(species, survey_year, protection_zone)
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = species,
    values_from = mean
  )
```

```{r}
# Create a summary dataframe for figure 2
zone_mean <- all_surveys_long |>
  # Take the mean of each species per protection zone per year
  summarize(
    mean = mean(value),
    .by = c(species, protection_zone)
  )
```

```{r}
# Figure 1: mean S. horneri percent cover over time for each protection zones
year_zone_mean |>
  ggplot(
    mapping = aes(
      x = as_factor(survey_year),
      y = cover_sarhor,
      color = protection_zone
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.7,
    position = position_jitter(height = 0, width = 0.1),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "New SMR" = "#56B4E9",
      "Old SMR" = "#009E73",
      "Reference" = "#D55E00",
      "SMCA" = "#E69F00"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "S. horneri cover at Anacapa Island",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Percent cover",
    color = "Protection zone"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(), # Remove grey space
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # Remove lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # Remove lines
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1) # Angle years
  )
```
